caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench with armrests and a backrest, colored in various shades of brown to illustrate the texture and grain of the wood. The bench has a rectangular seat and features a decorative pattern with geometric cutouts and spindle shapes in both the backrest and the lower front panel. Vertical, evenly spaced spindle supports are present on both the backrest and under the seat. The legs are straight and simple. The bench sits centered on a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or decorations. The artist's signature, "M. PARISH," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Bench
